Extracts response metadata from HTTP headers (etag, server, content-language)

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Crawlberg\Crawlberg;
$engine = Crawlberg::createEngine(null);
$url = "https://example.com";
$result = Crawlberg::scrape($engine, $url);
var_dump($result->statusCode);
var_dump($result->getResponseMeta()?->etag);
var_dump($result->getResponseMeta()?->lastModified);
var_dump($result->getResponseMeta()?->server);
var_dump($result->getResponseMeta()?->contentLanguage);
```
